claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: AZD7762 is a Chk1/2 inhibitor that is largely inactive as a single agent at 2.5 uM; it kills cells only when combined with DNA-damaging chemotherapy or radiation, so monotherapy in a 5-day pooled screen is expected to produce little or no killing.
